newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Air Nostrum adds more domestic routes.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Air Nostrum adds more domestic routes.

text.p: Spanish regional carrier Air Nostrum started four new domestic routes this month and is planning to start European flights early in 1998, spokesmen for the airline said.

The family-owned company, based in the east coast city of Valencia, will add five more Fokker 50 aircraft to its fleet of seven between now and the beginning of February and plans to take between three and seven 50 to 70 seat jet aircraft towards the end of next year.
It has done test flights so far with the Canadair Regional Jet and the Embraer 145 and says the Fokker 100 is also an option.
This week it inaugurated services from Valencia to Pamplona and then onto Santiago de Compostela, from Barcelona to Oviedo and from Madrid to Zaragoza. Last week it began a Valencia-Sevilla service.

The Valencia regional government is subsidising initial losses on the Valencia origin routes in exchange for tourism promotion on the flights. The airline now says it expects to make its first profit in 1998.
